paragraphs: SchoolPass sells a K-12 campus operations and safety platform that combines student safety, attendance, dismissal and parent engagement in one system. The company describes the product as an all-in-one platform built for schools, covering campus security, operations and communication.

Attendance and hall pass management marks students late or absent in real time against rosters and pushes statuses to the front office and the school's student information system. Dismissal management identifies vehicles in the carline automatically and organizes students for pickup by car, bus or after-school activity. Visitor management screens and badges visitors, flags custody violations and campus watch list entries, and checks visitors against a national sex offender database. Emergency attendance sends customizable alerts and lets staff mark students accounted for during a drill or emergency.

The buyers named on these pages are K-12 schools, with reporting that can cover a single school or an entire district. SchoolPass partners with student information system platforms including Blackbaud, PowerSchool, Veracross and Senior Systems to sync parent, student and attendance data.

quote.text: SchoolPass is the complete K-12 campus operations & safety solution.
